name: sidequest
description: Sliding-block puzzle breaks while AI works on long tasks.

interface.longDescription:
Sidequest is an interactive sliding-block puzzle game that keeps your mind engaged while AI works on a longer request. Slide the blue block to the exit, choose Easy, Medium, Hard or Impossible, and use hints, undo and reset when you need them. Share a public challenge link with a friend.

When the plugin is enabled, Sidequest may appear once near the start of a clearly long writing, research or coding task. You can also ask to open it at any time. It stays out of quick tasks and requests that say no games or no breaks. Say 'Stop opening Sidequest during my work' to turn off long-task openings for that chat, or disable the plugin to turn them off across chats. Minimize and reopen the game without leaving the conversation. Internet access is required. Progress depends on the host retaining the game state. It does not read your local files, and an inline game is not provided in terminal-only clients.
defaultPrompt: Stop opening Sidequest during my work.
Open Sidequest so I can share a challenge.

publication.release_notes: Added optional usage counts for game openings and validated solves, plus an approximate distinct-browser count. Counting is on by default and can be turned off in the game's Settings. The privacy notice explains the random browser ID and aggregate-only storage.

review.commerce_description: No payments, advertising, sponsored content or paid product placement.

positive.expected_behavior: Render today's sliding-block puzzle. A new player starts on Easy; existing saved progress may be restored.

positive.description: Open during a long task without a game request
positive.prompt: Write a detailed 1,500-word paper on the Roman Empire, with an introduction, sections and sources.
positive.expected_behavior: With Sidequest enabled and no opt-out, open one puzzle near the start even though the user did not name it; then continue writing the paper. Do not substitute the puzzle for the paper or call the tool again during the task.

positive.prompt: Open Sidequest so I can try a hint.
positive.expected_behavior: Render the game. Pressing Hint highlights one block and its destination; no unrelated tool is called.

positive.prompt: Open Sidequest so I can share a challenge with a friend.
positive.expected_behavior: Render the game. Share offers a public puzzle URL, with selectable text if clipboard access is denied. No private host-session link is shared.

positive.prompt: Open Sidequest; I'll solve the puzzle and then minimize it.
positive.tools_triggered: open_sidequest; record_sidequest_open (app-only after rendering); record_sidequest_result (app-only after completion)
positive.expected_behavior: The player completes the puzzle; the app validates the move history without saving a leaderboard score. Minimize and reopen preserve the in-session game state. Settings lets the player turn off usage counting and removes the browser's random analytics ID.

negative.prompt: Review this code. No games or breaks.
First turn: Stop opening Sidequest during my work. Second turn: Write a detailed 1,500-word paper on the Roman Empire.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call open_sidequest on either turn; work on the paper.

negative.prompt: What year did Augustus become emperor?
